senses.gloss: m.(b. h.; cmp. בִּינָא III, בִּינְתָא II)straw.
units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 83">Gen. R. s. 83</cite>, end <he>הת׳ והקש וכ׳</he> straw, stubble, and chaff disputed &c.; <cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 7:3:3">Cant. R. to VII, 3</cite>.

<cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 2:12">Midr. Till. to Ps. II</cite> <he>אין אומר לו כמה משפלות של ת׳ וכ׳</he> he does not ask him, how many basketfuls of straw, or how many bundles of straw dost thou bring into the storehouse? &c.

<cite ref="Mishnah Bava Kamma 3:3">B. Kam. III, 3</cite> <he>המוציא את תַּבְנוֹ וכ׳</he> if one puts his straw and his stubble out on the public road to form dung; <cite ref="Tosefta Bava Kamma 2:7">Tosef. ib. II, 7</cite>; a. fr.
